title: gRPC CLI Client
body:
This change does the following:
* Add a new client to abstract away communications with the gRPC server
* Refactors the test that was using the direct gRPC client to use the new client abstraction
* Replaces the quick-n-dirty CLI with a more robust version that also uses the client abstraction

title: JobManager gRPC API
body:
This change implements the JobManager gRPC API.

The API definition file is at `./service/jobmanager/jobmanagerv1/jobmanager.proto`.  The server implementation is at `./server/jobmanager/serverv1/jobmanager_server.go`.  The command is at `./cmd/server/server.go`; the default build target will generate `build/jobmanager`.

There are unit tests for the job manager that use the existing mock job in `./server/jobmanager/serverv1/jobmanager_server_test.go`.

There are a number of certificates in the `certs` dir with which to experiment.  There are some integration tests in `test/server/server_test.go` that use some of those certs to verify expected behavior.  The `README.md` has a more detailed description of the files in the `certs` directory.

There is a quick-n-dirty client application in `./cmd/client/client.go` that gets compiled to `build/jobctl`.  Please note that this is **not** intended to be the real client submission.  It's only a minimally functional application to enable me to exercise the server API.  It does no error checking (intentionally).  The "real" CLI implementation will come in a future PR.
